title: Ruins+
description: Adds ruins to vanilla Minecraft using data pack. adds 2 desert structures one with look and one without loot. adds ruins to terracotta biome one with loot and one without loot. adds warped ruins for nether loot and one for crimson no loot.
body:
Ruins+ is a lightweight datapack that adds a variety of custom ruins to your world, making exploration more interesting and rewarding. As you travel through different biomes, you’ll discover unique structures like desert ruins, jungle ruins, terracotta ruins. Each structure is designed to blend naturally into the terrain, sometimes partially buried or broken to give a realistic, ancient feel.

Some ruins contain loot chests with useful items such as armor, materials, and rare resources, while others focus on atmosphere and world-building. The pack keeps a vanilla-friendly style, so everything feels like it belongs in Minecraft without being overpowered or out of place.

Ruins+ is perfect for players who enjoy exploring and finding hidden secrets scattered across their world.
